summary.en: Offline measurement: does a verifier that sees a reply miss more errors than one that does not? Analysis rule fixed in advance.
summary.uz: Oflayn o'lchov: javobni ko'rgan tekshiruvchi ko'rmaganiga qaraganda ko'proq xato o'tkazib yuboradimi? Tahlil qoidasi oldindan belgilangan.

evidence.en: 36 of 36 injected errors caught; the hypothesis was not supported; the blind comparison failed its own validity gate. n = 12 per cell.
evidence.uz: 36 ta kiritilgan xatodan 36 tasi topildi; gipoteza tasdiqlanmadi; ko'r taqqoslash o'z yaroqlilik mezonidan o'tmadi. Har katakda n = 12.
evidence.ru: Поймано 36 из 36 внесённых ошибок; гипотеза не подтвердилась; слепое сравнение не прошло собственный критерий валидности. n = 12 на ячейку.
